cases.defect: The explanation presents a specific time as a necessary property of plans and makes desire and planning mutually exclusive. Plans need not have a fixed date, and querer can express intention or determination. The sentence communicates wanting to travel without establishing whether arrangements exist.
cases.correction: Ask «Що прямо виражає це речення?» and label a «Бажання поїхати до Мадрида.». Describe the examples specifically: «Quiero…» expresses desire; «El sábado voy…» presents an action as planned for Saturday. Remove the general requirement that a plan have a specific time.
